kapak.alt: The eardrum: thin, yet three layers

youtube.aciklama: The tympanic membrane (eardrum) is about 8 to 10 mm across but only about 0.1 mm thick. Even so, it has three layers: epithelium on the outside, a fibrous layer in the middle and mucosa on the inside.
